title: Review of lab 1's ad9-ledger (IB) on fresh seeds 5 and 6 at the world's defaults: planted droplets persist as bounded individuals (11-12 persistent tracks, area ratio 1.6-1.7) with a psi ring in 61/61 and 61/62 of them (rim/core 5.1 and 4.9)
summary: labkit re-runs of threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad9-ledger/world.py at its default parameters on fresh seeds 5 and 6 (frames 200, t=20000, 128^2; the claim has no labkit pack). Seed 5: 9-12 droplets, 11 persistent tracks, persistent-track area ratio 1.74, 7 splits (5 persistent, generation 1), 1 merge. Seed 6: 12 persistent tracks, ratio 1.61, 7 splits (6 persistent), 1 merge. rerun/seed5/tracks.png: tracks #8-#11 persist as round droplets of constant size from t~5000 to 20000. psi is membrane-like on both seeds (rim/core 5.11 and 4.94, rim/outside 15.2 and 14.9, in 61/61 and 61/62 individuals).

observations.I: rerun/seed5/tracks.png: tracks #8-#11 persist at constant size t~5000-20000; 11-12 persistent tracks per seed

verdicts.limitation: Run at the world's defaults, not the claim's kp=0.5/2.5 settings or the skeptic's seed 11. psi drifts up grad |grad phi|^2, a term written against the body field. I did not check how much of psi the droplet itself makes, or run kp=0, so B is not checked.
